title: board move <id> Review on a worktree's board exits 1 after moving
notes: From the screen-worker trial (#227). On a worktree's board a move is only a move, yet board move <id> Review writes the column and then exits 1 with "has no worktree to review; ship it first", because the branch's copy of the card has no worktree field. Every worker's move to Review prints a failure that did not fail. Fix: on a worktree's board, a move into Review or Ship does not ask the app to start anything, and exits 0.

comments.body: Hit all three workers of the 2026-11-07 batch (#227, #228, #229); each one's move && set && commit chain broke on the exit 1.
